authority: Marker recognition and a source hash never grant write permission. REPOSITORY-HANDOFF has no admitted writer.

inspection.privacy: Metadata by default; explicit local diff only for a selected file-backed source. Never execute preview/undo marker text. Public receipts omit bodies, absolute paths and private journal entries.

operation.unknownRule: After uncertain write intent, never infer that no write occurred. Explicit recovery may classify current bytes against recorded before/after only; other bytes remain unresolved.
operation.restoreRule: Restore is a NEW authorized operation with a verified backup of current bytes; no silent rollback and no overwrite of intervening edits.
operation.retentionRule: Keep at least the configured ordinary history plus every backup referenced by nonterminal or unresolved operations; no deletion of legacy backups during migration.
operation.concurrency: Cooperative per-target lock plus journal append lock, lock ordering fixed. Compare snapshots before replace. This is not an OS compare-and-swap against uncooperative writers and not an atomic multi-file batch.

excluded: automatic deletion or migration of legacy machine instructions
